note: Extra Living palm hands built by research-tools/living-palm/build.mjs from licensed Pexels photos + their REAL palm4_v2 scans. Only hands that passed the quality gate (390x844@3 and 1440x900, idle / lines / rotated +-18 deg) are listed. hero-palm-a is registered separately by the home hero. Each folder has the same asset set as hero-palm-a; palm-meta.json adds frame {content, pivot, palmEdges, wristFade} and lines.json adds labels {key: {uv, align}} placed automatically beside each real line.

hands.skinTone: deep brown (dark skin); label ink needs its light glow for contrast
hands.hand: right palm, fingers slightly apart, ring finger bent
hands.texture: 984 px wide (hand is small in the source photo); phone and desktop use the same albedo

hands.hand: right palm, open, fingers apart; source photo turned 90 deg so the fingers point up
left palm, long fingers held together, thumb out to the side (wide silhouette); source photo turned 90 deg

rejected.hero-palm-b: soft source photo with touching fingers: on +-18 deg rotation the finger sides smear into stretched 'fur' walls and the fingers read as clay
rejected.hand-type-a: scanner's line labels are anatomically implausible on this photo (heart traced across mid-palm, fate crossing head), no room for a fate label, sleeve fragment at the wrist
rejected.hand-type-b: same Pexels photo and hand as hero-palm-c (8062714); not built twice
rejected.palm-mounts, palm-fingers: no scan outline (cupped hand / same photo as hand-type-a)
